_comment: Streetmon types. chart[attacker][defender] is the damage multiplier; anything not listed is 1. Dual-typed defenders multiply both entries (2 x 2 = 4, 2 x 0.5 = 1). Wire and Sludge are the rooftop and sewer types; the original five-type cells are unchanged.

types.name: Gun
types.blurb: Ammo-fed. Reloading takes a full turn, the first shot after a reload hits twice as hard, and the noise gives them away.

types.name: Concrete
types.blurb: Tanks. They scatter broken glass that cuts anything switching in, and partly block projectiles.

types.name: Grind
types.blurb: Get stronger every turn they survive.

types.name: Smoke
types.blurb: Clouds that cut accuracy, evasion, choking and chip damage.

types.name: Bass
types.blurb: Fast. Sound waves hit every foe and can make them flinch.

types.name: Wire
types.blurb: Rooftop current: antennas, power lines and neon. Strong against Grind, Bass and Sludge; cut by Gun, grounded by Concrete, ground down by Grind.

types.name: Sludge
types.blurb: Sewer muck that corrodes and clogs. Strong against Gun and Concrete, shaken apart by Bass and shocked by Wire.
